name: Tellie
soft_passes: #1 self-masks to squircle with no radius fighting, but bakes the drop shadow the system should apply — Tahoe-era mismatch
#3 filled black the tile is just a rounded square; identity lives in internal value/colour (notch + orange), not outer shape
#4 brand gestalt (orange field + dark top notch) survives 16px, but the caption rows + thin beige tracks smear — the live-caption subject is unreadable small
#7 white pills/black notch clear 3:1, but beige tracks #E5C19C on orange are near-isoluminant and wash out in grayscale
#9 predominantly Big Sur, but the raised bevel frame + baked tile shadow are a flat-transition/framed-tile quotation, not current-era
failures: #10 single baked raster with hardcoded orange field + baked shadow; not separable Icon Composer layers, so no clean dark/clear/tinted variants — lags the Liquid Glass kit

palette.background: ramp #EE9550->#DD7838 (orange field) inside silver bevel frame #EFEFEF->#D0D0D0

light_model: top-down (Big Sur); frame bevel highlights top and darkens bottom, orange ramp light-top to dark-bottom, white pills carry short soft micro-shadow; one consistent source
devices: the notch as protagonist (black pill pinned to the field's top edge, literalizing 'gives every Mac a notch')
live-caption transcript (centre-aligned white word-pills flanked by dim beige tracks = current word bright, upcoming words quiet)
raised silver bevel frame (framed-tile motif enclosing the field)
baked squircle + self-baked drop shadow in a ~10% transparent margin (pre-Tahoe delivery)
rhymes_hint: UI-mimic utility icons (glyph is a miniature of the app's own interface — dictation/transcription/menu-bar tools); Big-Sur framed-tile icons with a light bevel ring; warm-orange productivity icons
notes: 512x512 web render of the 1024 master, so hex are +/-3 and beige-track edges are softened by downscale. Strong subject-mining: the icon draws the product's defining behaviour (notch + word-by-word highlight) rather than a generic glyph-on-gradient, confirmed coherent against cover.png (same brand orange, same current-vs-pending highlight). Cost is detail-density that weakens the 16px and silhouette reads. Candidate cross-icon patterns for later promotion: 'app's own UI as the icon glyph' and 'current-vs-pending shown as bright-fill vs dim-track'. Single icon — nothing promotable yet.
